Davis-Rea Ltd increased its stake in Goldman Sachs Group (GS) by 30.02% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Davis-Rea Ltd bought 4,278 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.52% with the market. The institutional investor held 18,528 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.72 million, up from 14,250 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Davis-Rea Ltd who had been investing in Goldman Sachs Group for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $91.28B market cap company. The stock increased 1.97% or $4.66 $241.66. About 1.85 million shares traded. The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. (NYSE:GS) has risen 9.66% underperformed by 1.89% the S&P500.
Grassi Investment Management increased its stake in Apple Computer (AAPL) by 2.6% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Grassi Investment Management bought 2,652 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 104,528 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $17.69 million, up from 101,876 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Grassi Investment Management who had been investing in Apple Computer for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $949.20B market cap company. The stock increased 0.55% or $1.02 $187.07.
